Buyer question: what must be true before Azure DevOps is worth buying versus staying on Basic (first 5 users)?

Keep Azure DevOps on the shortlist only if Microsoft/Azure-native engineering orgs; drop it when Open-source and GitHub-community-first teams because User 6 onwards is list price for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround cannot be patched with more seats.

sections.heading: Azure DevOps limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: User 6 onwards is list price for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround; Test Plans at list price is a QA licence, not something to assign to every developer; Pipeline minutes and Artifacts storage are extra TCO beyond seats because it forces process changes or add-ons around Azure DevOps when log management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: stay on Basic (first 5 users) until log management is mandatory; plan jumps to Basic only after that hinge is proven.

Plan trade-off: you gain log management at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Basic (first 5 users) · free · log management | Basic | Basic + Test Plans.

Alternative context: unlike GitHub, Azure DevOps is preferable when Microsoft/Azure-native engineering orgs because log management plus log management match; prefer GitHub when Open-source and GitHub-community-first teams because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Azure DevOps
sections.body:
Scenario: recommend Azure DevOps for Microsoft/Azure-native engineering orgs; do not choose it when Open-source and GitHub-community-first teams — the jobs diverge at log management.

Implementation time: weeks to configure log management if Microsoft Teams must be green before invites.

Integrations in research: Microsoft Teams.

Decision conclusion: buy Azure DevOps when researched fit (Microsoft/Azure-native engineering orgs) beats researched limits (User 6 onwards is list price for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround); otherwise keep researching — do not substitute product names into a generic implementation essay.
